cost_definition: assistant_calls counts recorded assistant-role messages; excludes unrecorded API retries and is not an API bill. messages counts all recorded trajectory messages.
boolean_audit: Strict accepts True/False/1/0; old resolved == 1 string check rejects True. No legacy estimates copied.

definitions.p: Uniform issue (n>=2), uniformly chosen first attempt success probability.
definitions.q: Same issue sampling; uniform ordered distinct attempt pair, second success conditional on first failure; ratio of issue-averaged joint and failure probabilities.
definitions.icc: Correlation of two uniformly chosen distinct binary attempts from a uniformly chosen issue: (E[Y1Y2]-p^2)/(p(1-p)). Equals 1-q/p for this estimand; not ANOVA ICC.
definitions.ci: Percentile issue bootstrap; all observations from a sampled issue stay together.

queue.calibration: Frozen 27B train_rates structure, PRIOR_CALLS=2000, training-failure terciles, repository category with >=10 training issues; OpenHands training-half numerical calibration. No test threshold selection.
queue.numeric_transfer: Separately replay serialized rounded 27B global fresh/retry rates and edges without refit. No language metadata alignment: global fallback only; message-cost replay is an unscaled unit-mismatch sensitivity, not calibrated transfer.
queue.interval_scope: Percentile intervals over heldout issue resampling and random attempt selection/order; conditioning on the once-fitted training calibration, not including training-fit uncertainty.
queue.sampling: Issue bootstrap of heldout set; draw 3 attempts uniformly without replacement in random order per sampled issue. Same issue draws, attempt orders, and fresh tie order for every policy and both costs.
queue.budget: 20/30/40/50% of total cost of all three sampled attempts; analytical ex-post normalization, never exposed to policy. Prefix ends at first over-budget attempt; no future-cost skipping. spent_cost means completed-run cost; interrupted remainder gets zero solves.
queue.empty_patch_definition: patch_empty is model_patch is null OR model_patch.strip()=='' (nulls treated as no observed patch); model_EmptyPatch is separately retained as exit-status-derived metadata. Only already completed failed attempts expose patch_empty to the queue.
queue.short_nonempty: Short/nonempty = train bottom failure-cost tercile AND no empty patch in observed failures; long/empty = upper tercile OR any empty patch in observed failures; middle group stays between them. Compare reversed group priority with same random fresh order; restarts only after all fresh issues. No future failure features.
